description: Replacement of 2no existing single glazed timber framed windows to the front elevation and 1no existing single glazed timber framed window to the rear elevation with new double glazed uPVC framed windows at first floor level.

waste_details.reason_for_no_provision: The proposed development does not affect existing waste storage arrangements. The property is a two-flat maisonette and accordingly, it has no dedicated internal or external storage provision for recycling, food waste or residual waste (as may be required in a wider residential development). No changes to the existing waste storage arrangements are proposed or will be altered as part of this application.

subdivision_of_building: The proposals do not cover the whole existing building. The works are limited to the first-floor flat at 43 Tasso Road and comprise the replacement of three existing windows within that residential unit only. The ground floor flat and the remainder of the building are unaffected by the proposed development.
